name: Coding Mismatch — Upper GI Endoscopy with Biopsy
description: Diagnosis-procedure mismatch denial. ICD-10 code doesn't clearly support endoscopy. Requires coding correction + clinical justification.

denial.denialLetterText:
Aetna
Claims Adjudication Department

DATE: February 20, 2026

RE: Denial of Claim — 43239 (Upper GI endoscopy with biopsy)

Dear Provider,

This letter is to inform you that the claim submitted for the above-referenced service has been denied.

DENIAL REASON: CO11 — The diagnosis is inconsistent with the procedure

PAYER STATEMENT: Diagnosis code does not support the medical necessity of the procedure. The submitted diagnosis of GERD with esophagitis does not independently justify biopsy during endoscopy.

PROCEDURE: 43239 — Upper GI endoscopy with biopsy
DIAGNOSIS: K21.0 — Gastro-esophageal reflux disease with esophagitis

APPEAL RIGHTS: You have the right to appeal this denial within 120 days.

APPEAL DEADLINE: June 20, 2026

Sincerely,
Claims Adjudication Department
Aetna
